chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Bukayr, from Zurara, who said:

I said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): 'What do you say regarding a man who presents two just witnesses, and presents two of his wives, and they are both pure (from menstruation) without copulation, then says: 'Bear witness that these two wives of mine are divorced', and they are both pure. Does the divorce occur?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'Yes'.
ai.seo_question: Does a single divorce declaration apply to two wives if they are pure and not yet consummated?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi highlights the juristic principle that a single verbal declaration can effectuate divorce on multiple wives if the conditions of purity and absence of intercourse are met, a ruling confirmed by Imam al-Sadiq (AS). It underscores the Shia emphasis on the efficacy of the husband's intent and the specific state of the wives at the time of utterance, distinguishing it from other schools that may require separate declarations or different conditions for multiple divorces.
